_meta.description: Pre-registered spec for Tunneling+ v4 (pitcher-season grain). Locked before results. Same convention as Stuff+ v4, Location+ v3, Deception+ v2b.

features_candidate.lag_numerics: 6 lag slots x (commit_distance, plate_distance, shape_break) = 18 means per pitcher-season
features_candidate.arsenal_entropy: Shannon entropy over post-exclusion usage shares (candidate, subject to ablation)

target: mean delta_run_exp per pitcher-season (delta_run_exp IS NOT NULL)

ablation.adoption_rule: inconclusive_means_drop: diff(with vs without) <= 0.03 MAE -> drop feature

validation_gates.sign_check: r(v4_score, mean_dre) < 0 (lower mean_dre = worse pitch outcomes = should map to lower score)
validation_gates.score_spread: target > 12 pts spread (v3 was 9 pts -- grain change meant to fix this)
validation_gates.predictive_validity: at least one outcome (xwOBA, whiff%, swstr%, K%, BB%, chase%) shows r with same direction as sign check
validation_gates.independence: r(Stuff+) < 0.5, r(Location+) < 0.5 (should be a distinct dimension)

note_on_part0: Part 0 diagnostic uses mean_dre as ERA/xFIP proxy since real ERA is not stored in the DB. This is an internal-consistency check, not fully independent validation.
